face.name: 奥术冲击
face.text: 对一个随从造成 2点伤害。该法术受到的法术伤害增益效果翻倍。
face.flavorText: 双倍效果，双重感受！

face.name: Arcane Blast
face.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. This spell gets double bonus from Spell Damage.
face.flavorText: Now with 100% more blast!

face.name: 法力虹吸
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。荣誉消灭：使你手牌中所有法术牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 既然能用你的法力，为什么要用自己的？

face.name: Siphon Mana
face.text: Deal 2 damage. Honorable Kill: Reduce the Cost of spells in your hand by (1).
face.flavorText: Why spend mine when I can take yours?

face.name: 月蚀
face.text: 对一个随从造成 3点伤害。在本回合中，你施放的下一个法术的法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 当艾泽拉斯运行到太阳和月亮之间时发生的现象。

face.name: Lunar Eclipse
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Your next spell this turn costs (2) less.
face.flavorText: When the Azeroth is between the Sun and the Moon.

face.name: 弹溅射击
face.text: 随机对三个敌人造成 1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 简单几何学？很难的啦。

face.name: Ricochet Shot
face.text: Deal 1 damage to three random enemies.
face.flavorText: Simple geometry? Actually, I find it's quite complex.

face.name: 永歌传送门
face.text: 召唤 1只4/4并具有突袭的山猫（受法术伤害加成影响）。
face.flavorText: 回想一下，他们准备了那么多山猫，确实下了不少功夫。

face.name: Eversong Portal
face.text: Summon 1 4/4 (Lynx, Lynxes) with Rush (improved by Spell Damage).
face.flavorText: In retrospect, it's pretty impressive that they had the Lynxes just ready to go.

face.name: 考前刷夜
face.text: 抽 1张牌（受法术伤害加成影响）。
face.flavorText: 教材上的奥术字体能赋予你近乎无穷的威力与能量！但它不能让你保持清醒，提神还得靠咖啡。

face.name: Cram Session
face.text: Draw 1 (card, cards) (improved by Spell Damage).
face.flavorText: The font of the arcane gives nearly limitless access to power and energy! But it can't keep you awake, for that we still use coffee.

face.name: 闪光试剂瓶
face.text: 造成 2点伤害。在本回合中，你的下一张牌减少与伤害量相同的法力值消耗。
face.flavorText: 水瓶仍待提高。

face.name: Sparkling Phial
face.text: Deal 2 damage. Your next card this turn costs that much less.
face.flavorText: Lemme pull up your phial.

face.name: 艾萨拉的恩赐
face.text: 抽一张牌。如果你在本牌在你手中时使用过纳迦牌，再抽一张。
face.flavorText: 理发师：你想要什么发型？ 纳迦：你想要奥术的力量吗？ 理发师：好了别说了。

face.name: Gifts of Azshara
face.text: Draw a card. If you played a Naga while holding this, do it again.
face.flavorText: Barber: What do you want? Naga: You ever have a thirst for arcane power? Barber: Say no more.

face.name: 诺甘农的智慧
face.text: 抽两张牌。在本局对战中，你每施放过一个不同派系的法术，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 现在我们所需的还剩下诺甘农的力量与勇气。

face.name: Wisdom of Norgannon
face.text: Draw 2 cards. Costs (1) less for each different spell school you've cast this game.
face.flavorText: Now all we need is the power and courage of Norgannon.

face.name: 星体射击
face.text: 造成 3点伤害。你的下一个法术拥有法术伤害+2。
face.flavorText: 这一箭确实是星体射的。

face.name: Celestial Shot
face.text: Deal 3 damage. Your next spell has Spell Damage +2.
face.flavorText: He sure did.

face.name: 永歌山猫
face.text: 突袭

face.name: Eversong Lynx
face.text: Rush

uncertainties: Damage outcomes, original next-use modifiers and next-CAST Spell Damage use the existing local public contracts, not current CN edge calibration.

TSC_948 uses the captured actual friendly Naga hand-play commitment while the original card was held; countered hand plays count as committed plays. Its physical progress lifecycle is the original public one.
SCH_353 and RLK_819 freeze one current actual-CAST Arcane Spell Damage total at payload acceptance; later reactions do not recalculate their original numeric count.
TTN_085 uses distinct nonempty schools of all accepted nonfailed own CAST payloads, including automatic and repeated casts, without changing legacy hand-root-only price policies.
TOY_800 takes the captured original DamageResult.damage_dealt, including its ordinary armor/overkill conventions; prevention or no damage grants no cost modifier.
TIME_857 remains closed until all actual source dependencies are available; no raw candidate is pruned.
